text:
alex_ops: FYI crate B12 landed at FRA this morning. 6/8 H100s show obvious physical damage (bent heatsinks, scratched fins) and two units are completely unresponsive. Photos here: https://drive.redwood/shipment/B12 :grimacing:

maria_procure: PO 2026-4490 on file. Sophie/NovaCompute, what's your proposed RMA flow and realistic lead times? We need to plan cluster allocations and possibly shift canaries.

kevin_logistics: Inspection report incoming. If we go air-replace we'll need AWB + proforma (HS 8471.80). Depot needs vendor pre-auth for outbound and clarity on who covers return freight.

chris_sre: Impact note: eu-west-1 loses ~4 usable GPUs if we pull all damaged. Canary tonight might need to be narrowed or postponed. Alex, can you post affected serials?

alex_ops: Manifests show:
H100-CA-00123
H100-CA-00124
H100-CA-00125
H100-CA-00126
H100-CA-00127
H100-CA-00128
H100-CA-00129
H100-CA-00130
Damaged: 00123-00128. DOA: 00125 (smoked), 00128 (no power).

sophie_vendor: Hi all 014 Sophie from NovaCompute. Sorry about the trouble. We'll open RMA immediately. Options: air-express (5 business days after approval) or ground replacement (12-18 business days). We can cover DOA + damage under warranty and provide return labels for accepted returns. For air we normally charge an expedite fee unless covered by contract.

maria_procure: Estimate for expedite fee? Also confirm you'll provide AWB and prefilled customs paperwork so depot can hand off quickly.

sophie_vendor: Expedite fee ~EUR 2,800/unit for air (rush handling + freight). We can offer a partial immediate ship: 4 refurbished loaners by air same-day and the other 4 replacements ground shipment in 10-14 days. If you accept the partial ship we can waive expedite fees on the loaners.

kevin_logistics: If loaners arrive we need a crossdock RMA workflow: vendor AWB -> temporary asset tags -> serial escrow doc. Can Nova include temp-serial manifest for tracking?

sophie_vendor: Yes. We'll include temp IDs and an RMA (NOV-RMA-2026-1147). We'll attach an SLA for loaners with return window and condition checklist. RMA + AWB once we get photo packet and purchase order confirmation.

nina_finance: Need line items comparing air-refurb vs full ground replace. Also need vendor waiver in writing before we amend PO.

maria_procure: Sending preliminary line items to @nina_finance. Sophie, please confirm the vendor will absorb DOA replacements and return freight costs in writing.

sophie_vendor: Confirmed in writing here: NovaCompute will absorb DOA replacements and return freight for DOA/damaged units we accept. Formal waiver/quote to follow.

chris_sre: Mitigation: I'll scope canary to a single AZ and shift non-critical batch jobs to us-west-2 for 48-72h. If loaners land today we can keep the original plan. Please update ASAP.

alex_ops: Uploaded photos + manifest: https://drive.redwood/shipment/B12/photos. Shared access granted to @sophie_vendor.

deploy-bot: Canary pipeline for service/ml-inference paused automatically due to capacity degradation in eu-west-1. Resume once @chris_sre or @alex_ops confirm capacity restored.

maria_procure: Action items:
1) Nova to generate NOV-RMA and AWB by EOD (sophie_vendor)
2) Nova to ship 4 loaners by air (waived expedite if partial ship accepted) (sophie_vendor)
3) Finance approval for expedite up to EUR 11,000 if waiver not granted (nina_finance)
4) Ops to confirm serial escrow + return labels (alex_ops, kevin_logistics)
5) SRE to adjust canary window (chris_sre)

kevin_logistics: I'll prepare the depot handoff note and customs pre-clearance once AWB is received. Recommend we assemble a claim packet with photos for insurance.

sophie_vendor: RMA draft NOV-RMA-2026-1147 created. AWB and final docs pending photo packet and PO confirmation. Expect email + Slack update in ~3 hours.

alex_ops: Received RMA draft. Depot to accept vendor AWB once docs signed.

kevin_logistics: If air departs today ETA to FRA depot ~24-36h. I'll coordinate dock slot if we get signoff.

chris_sre: Holding canary until loaner confirmation. Thanks.

sophie_vendor: Will post final AWB/tracking here when ready.

alex_ops: Resolving for now. Follow-ups on tracking and physical returns in this thread.
